title: Chicken Broccoli Salad (Community Enhanced)
ingredients: 3 cooked skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cubed
instructions: Combine broccoli, chicken, walnuts, and green onions in a large bowl.
Add salt and pepper to the mayonnaise, vinegar, and sugar, then whisk together in a bowl until well blended.
Pour mayonnaise dressing over broccoli mixture; toss to coat.
Cover and refrigerate until chilled, if desired. Sprinkle with crumbled bacon to serve.

source_review.text: This salad is exceptional! I adore the bacon/chicken combo it is super in this salad. Love the crunch of the walnuts. Simply added S&P to the dressing before whisking it up. I used raw broccoli. Thanks for sharing
